reasoning_traces.think:
The Data Shapley framework defines each data point’s marginal contribution to model performance via a combinatorial sum over all possible subsets. This formulation ensures uniqueness under standard axioms—null element, symmetry, and linearity. In practice, computing this exactly is intractable for large datasets. The KNN-Shapley dynamic program offers an efficient approximation by leveraging the assumption that a KNN classifier on pre-logit features mirrors full model behavior. This enables practical deployment in GSE's batch acquisition pipeline. The key insight is that Shapley values can identify informative yet potentially noisy or out-of-distribution samples, such as minority clusters in linear classifiers, which uncertainty-based methods might overlook. By filtering these via Shapley values before applying diversity criteria, ADS improves robustness and efficiency. The failure mode arises when the pre-logit space fails to preserve discriminative structure relevant to the downstream task, leading to poor value estimates.
